explication: Kernel provides sandboxed Chromium sessions for browser automation, with optional interactive live view and session replay. The main workflow is an automation client connecting over CDP to a running browser; the API also exposes browser controls and agent-oriented tools. A wrapper starts and monitors the browser environment. Separate branches cover the remote GUI and lifecycle telemetry/standby. The README documents these capabilities; unsampled API and UI internals are represented at their enclosing source paths, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
